dedupe_keys.name: planned road works on the national highways road network

description: Planned road works on the National Highways road network is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Highways. This dataset provides information on planned roadworks carried out on the National Highways network. Roadworks listed cover the period up to 15 days in advance from the date of publication. It should be taken as a general indication of what is planned but individual closures could change right up to point of ‘go live’. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher National Highways. It offers 760 resource(s) in API, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
